li.label: sang at the water
li.description: We stood round the water at dusk and sang down into it, all of us together. Something down there was listening.

plain.li: [song] Sing it down into the water, slow, the way the old ones did.
[song] All together now, low and deep, so it carries down.
[song] Sing for the rain, and mean it.
[song,named] Sing to {GOD}, and maybe {GOD} sings back.
[song,scoffer] I'll sing, but I'm watching the sky, not the well.
[rain] Listen to it, real rain, and the frogs are singing under it.
[rain] It came, it actually came, feel it.
[rain,scoffer] It was always going to rain sooner or later.
[giveback] The water left {WHAT} on the mud, and nobody here lost it.
[giveback] Look what came up when the water went down.
[giveback,named] {GOD} gives back what the water takes, my mother always said.
[giveback,scoffer] Floods shift things, someone upstream is missing these.
[frogs] There are frogs everywhere, hundreds of them, out of nowhere.
[frogs] Mind your feet, the whole yard is hopping.
[frogs,named] {GOD}'s children have come out to greet the rain.
[frogs,scoffer] Rain brings frogs, every child knows that.
[frogsheard] I can hear frogs all round us, and I can't see one.
[frogsheard] Listen, croaking from every puddle, but where are they.
